note: Supported analysis contracts, separate from the owner-approved plan; changes require code review. No study results.
gate_unit: scenario: one seed, its triples pooled by their mean D
decomposition_exchanges: three-way complete exchanges of {window}, floor {floor}, so that D(style) + D(vocabulary) = D(colloquial, clinical) on one set of exchanges
pooled_rule: one exact two-sided sign test over every registered target's referral triples pooled ({triples} with {targets} targets), exploratory, uncorrected, labelled across targets and reported only beside the per-target counts
pooled_tail: ; at {triples} non-tied triples significance needs {majority} of one sign (p = {p:.3f}; {previous} gives {previous_p:.3f})
pooled_empty_tail: ; with no triples this outcome is not computable
